fieldValues.title: A registry server can only be reached from its own machine
fieldValues.statement: I need to read, and where allowed write, the repositories a registry server holds from another machine: a cloud routine, a second laptop, another server resolving a remote locator. srs mcp serve speaks stdio only, so a server is reachable only by a process on its own host, and an RFC-049 remote locator answers locator-unusable.
